change.before: "Content-Type header was auto-detected when not set by the backend"
change.after: "Content-Type header is not auto-detected when not set by the backend"

of.needed: whether the environment relies on automatic Content-Type header detection from backend responses that lack explicit Content-Type

consequence.statement: Backend responses without an explicit Content-Type header will no longer have the Content-Type automatically detected; the ContentType middleware must be explicitly configured to restore this behavior.
consequence.remediation: Configure the ContentType middleware on routes that depend on automatic Content-Type detection from backends that do not set the Content-Type header.

assertion.statement: In Traefik 3.0, automatic Content-Type header detection is removed when the backend does not set the Content-Type header; the ContentType middleware must be explicitly used to enable this detection.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
